title: Infinite-horizon controllability scores for linear time-invariant systems
summary: We formulate infinite-horizon controllability scores for linear time-invariant systems whose conventional controllability Gramians may diverge. A mode-dependent scaling yields finite-horizon volumetric controllability score (VCS) and average energy controllability score (AECS) problems that are exactly equivalent to the original ones, while the scaled Gramians converge as the horizon tends to infinity.
